clock_sensitivity.note: prefill is compute work at 1017 sums per byte against a ridge of 140, so it follows the clock; decode reads the weights once and two thirds of it is memory, which does not

instruction_paths_in_llama_ptx.note: the library ships PTX and is compiled at load, so which path runs is a runtime choice

dp4a_peak.note: rules dp4a out as the prefill path by a factor of 28

open: whether a wider token tile would raise IMMA utilisation, which is a change to llama.cpp and was not tried

matrix_peaks_at_2947mhz.note: both probes reach the same share of a clean power-of-two rate, which is why the two numbers can be compared

prefill_share_of_ceiling.note: the INT8 line is the ceiling: 81.4% of kernel time and effectively all of the sums are on IMMA

kernel_time_by_family_pp512.source: nsys-kernel-summary.csv, one llama-bench pp512 run (warmup plus one measured prompt)
kernel_time_by_family_pp512.instruction_evidence: fork docs/task_workflow/output/nv-llama-prefill-lifecycle-audit.md: SASS shows IMMA.16832 (Q4_K) and IMMA.16816 (Q6_K), no HMMA, no dp4a

prefill_by_context_at_2655mhz.note: flat within 0.3% from 512 to 2048: work per token is constant once the grid fills the machine

mul_mat_q_pipe_utilisation.source: ncu-pipe-utilisation.csv and ncu-memory-and-tensor.csv, percent of peak sustained active
mul_mat_q_pipe_utilisation.finding: not DRAM bound: DRAM idle at 7.5% and L2 catches 88%. Load-store and L1 are busiest at 40%, above the matrix pipe at 31.6%. Unpacking Q4_K, applying scales and staging operands into shared memory is proportional to the matrix work, not amortised by it.
mul_mat_q_pipe_utilisation.cross_check: IMMA at 31.6% independently confirms the 29.3% computed from wall clock
mul_mat_q_pipe_utilisation.caveat: ncu replays kernels, so durations in these CSVs are not wall-clock

tile_intensity.note: a 128-token tile sits on the memory side of the roofline even though the 512-token prompt at 1017 sits on the compute side. This predicted a DRAM bound kernel, which was wrong; the traffic is real but it lands in L2.
